economy_result.nerosecurity.absent: Paid security tiers need NeroEconomy, which is not installed on this server.
quest.nerosecurity.access_granted.card_s: Every lock starts with a key. Craft a blank keycard; it opens nothing until it is encoded.
quest.nerosecurity.access_granted.first_: Encode your first keycard. From here on, access to your base is something you hand out on purpose.
quest.nerosecurity.access_granted.head_o: Keycard encoded, hub online, drill passed. Your base is yours to open and yours to close.
quest.nerosecurity.access_granted.instal: Register a security hub and link at least one device to it. One hub decides who gets in, so every door answers to the same rules.
quest.nerosecurity.access_granted.lockdo: Trigger a lockdown on your own installation, then clear it. A drill, not an alarm: know the way out before you ever need it.
